title: Do the 8 paqad agents keep Bash?
context: Agent lint AG-022 flags Bash as a risky power on all 8 agents (planning, specification, development, review, checks, documentation-sync, expert, chief-architect) until an owner-resolved authoring.agent_permission packet allows it. Every stage runs paqad-ai verbs through Bash, and the expert and chief-architect seats use it to record their notes. The answer sets what the agent-permission packets will ask you to allow; those packets are still raised and answered separately.
